raw.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The AWS Data Center Systems team seeks a Manager of Data Center Systems software to manage a software development team building the next generation User Interface for datacenter infrastructure controls monitoring and alarming systems.  
  
This is an opportunity to build global cloud monitoring applications using device telemetry from the industrial control systems. In particular, you will own the the UI/UX, presenting a consolidated, consistent view of AWS Data Centers’ status giving our users a high degree of Situational Awareness for AWS Data Centers around the world. These systems directly contribute to the high availability of AWS data centers, and Amazon’s sustainability goals.  
  
As a Manager in Data Center Systems Software, you will ensure that data center systems are designed with high reliability, security, availability, scalability, and low latency from the outset. You will establish development standards, best practices, and drive operational excellence throughout your team. You will hire and develop the best engineers to accomplish the organization's goals and mission. The relationships you build with peers will help ensure the group is using the right AWS services and methodologies for the company’s scale, while recognizing the unique requirements of the data center systems problem space.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of software engineers, fostering an inclusive and high-ownership culture.

  

* Own end-to-end delivery of services and features — from planning and design through launch and operation.

  

* Set and communicate technical direction; ensure sound architecture, operational excellence, and appropriate trade-offs between speed and long-term health.

  

* Drive operational excellence for mission-critical systems, including on-call health, availability, latency, and security.

  

* Partner with product management and operations customers to translate ambiguous goals into clear, measurable roadmaps.

  

* Collaborate across teams to align on shared platforms, interfaces, and dependencies.

  

* Manage planning and execution, proactively identifying and removing risks and blockers.

  

* Coach engineers on design, code quality, and career growth; calibrate performance and support promotions.

  
A day in the life  
No two days are identical, but a typical one blends technical leadership, delivery, and people management. You unblock your team at stand-up, review designs and push on the right trade-offs, and watch on-call health and metrics on systems where availability is non-negotiable. You align with product and partner teams on interfaces and roadmap, coach engineers in 1:1s, give feedback on reviews, and help with hiring. The best people move fluidly between the strategic (where should this platform be in a year?) and the specific (why did this deployment regress p99?), and make the teams around them better.  
  
About the team  
DC Console is a team inside DC Bridge, spun up to enable other teams to deliver value quickly to a single pane of glass for our Data Center Community without the cost of waiting on away team pipelines.
  
  
\*Why AWS\*  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
\*Work/Life Balance\*  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
\*Inclusive Team Culture\*  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
\*Mentorship and Career Growth\*  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Benefits

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-
No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

About the Role
Shield AI is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead execution of our aircraft development efforts supporting the U.S. Air Force’s Ranger program. This leader will translate customer objectives into an integrated execution plan spanning concept development, aircraft and mission systems integration, prototype demonstration, flight test, and production readiness.
You will partner closely with the program leader, Chief Engineer, engineering teams, manufacturing, supply chain, and government stakeholders to deliver against technical, schedule, and cost commitments. Success requires balancing mission capability with affordability, modularity, and speed—making disciplined decisions about what must be developed, what can be reused, and what is required to demonstrate readiness for the next phase.
The ideal candidate combines engineering depth with program leadership experience and a record of delivering complex aerospace systems under demanding timelines. You can challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and build alignment across organizations while maintaining clear ownership of program outcomes.
 
What You’ll Do
Own integrated program execution. Establish and maintain the program baseline, connecting engineering deliverables, hardware availability, supplier commitments, integration activities, test events, and customer milestones.
Translate customer needs into executable plans. Partner with systems engineering and technical leadership to define program scope, measurable success criteria, requirements priorities, and verification milestones as the program evolves.
Drive multidisciplinary coordination. Align air vehicle, propulsion, avionics, flight controls, autonomy, mission systems, and ground systems teams around dependencies and interface commitments.

raw.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.

- Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.

- Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.

- Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

- Report on and analyze supply and material health to inform key decisions for Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Business Development.

- Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

- Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)

- 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.

- Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.

- Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.

- Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

- Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

- Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Master’s degree or other higher education.

- Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.

- Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.

- Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.

- Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, six sigma principles, and big data evaluation techniques.

- Proactive, able to take substantial responsibility across various functions, with a focus on speed and accuracy.

- Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance.

raw.title: Senior Manager, Product Operations
raw.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Frontier Systems (AFS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized hardware and software products for defense, law enforcement, and intelligence customers. We work alongside our customers to understand their requirements and deliver exquisite capabilities across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.

Product Operations is the team accountable for the health of the systems and technology that delivers the capabilities that our customers depend on. The function identifies, triages, and drives resolution of incidents across the deployed fleet, and converts what we've learned into the reliability and sustainment insights that product and engineering teams act upon. We work in close coordination with product engineering, reliability, quality, program management, and field operations teams to maximize capability availability for our end users and inform the next cycle of iterations.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Manager of Product Operations for Frontier Systems, you will own product operations across the division's product portfolio and the programs that deliver those products. You will lead multiple Product Operations managers, each of whom runs a team of technical specialists and engineers focused on supporting and improving fielded products. The division's portfolio is scaling, and this role exists to scale support alongside it, both for the products the function covers today and for the ones that reach the field next.

This is a function maturation and growth role as much as an operating one, and the work rewards depth. The position requires a strong problem-solving mindset, enough technical depth to follow the work of the engineers and specialists supporting fielded robotic systems, and the judgment to make decisions whose impact reaches beyond your own team and the current planning cycle. If you are passionate about cutting-edge technology, advancing national security, and delivering best-in-class operational support, Anduril invites you to join the team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead and Grow the Function: Lead Product Operations across the Frontier Systems portfolio, managing multiple teams and driving the growth of both sustainment capability and resourcing across the division. Own hiring, performance, development, and organizational design, while also maturing the function itself: the operating model, the standards, and the capability of the people in it.

Own Service Quality, Internal and External: Hold accountability for the quality of product support delivered to external customers and to internal Anduril teams. Understand the work at every level, both how it is expected to be done and how it is actually being done, and close the distance between the two.

Scale Support Operations Across the Portfolio: Think strategically about how support scales across the division's full portfolio, current and future. Extend Product Operations coverage to new products and programs as they reach fielded maturity, standing up scope, coverage, escalation paths, and support infrastructure where none exists. All while holding service quality steady as the fielded population grows.

Align Capacity to Demand: Align support headcount demand to measured support volume, fielded asset population, and product delivery schedules. Own annual headcount planning for the function and produce defensible demand calculations when planning cycles call for them.

Own the Failure Signal and the fielded product Reliability Loop: Own the workflow that converts field failures into structured, trustworthy signal for product and reliability engineering, spanning failure mode classification, root cause corrective action cycle performance, and recurrence measurement. Partner with engineering to abstract individual incidents into systemic improvements, holding engineering partners accountable to the signal provided and your own organization accountable to its fidelity.

Set the Support and Sustainment Standard: Establish and enforce the standards by which the organization triages, diagnoses, escalates, and resolves product incidents, including the severity discipline that determines what reaches engineering and when. Mature the sustainment approach for complex electromechanical products supporting the evolution of maintenance, spares and hardware action, configuration and calibration management, and the self-service and tooling investments that reduce support burden over time.

Sponsor Function Initiatives: Outline and sponsor the initiatives that mature the function, defining the end state, the measure of success, and the resourcing. Then hold program management partners accountable for leading and delivering the targeted outcomes.

Be the Interface for Support Requirements: Serve as the point of contact program teams come to when assessing product and customer service support requirements for new and expanding programs. Characterize the cost of the service and define the contract and pricing structures that fund it, in support of proposals and modifications.

Brief Executive Stakeholders: Represent product support to business line and division leadership through recurring reviews of fleet health, reliability trends, sustainment cost, and the maturation of the service. Surface systemic problems with evidence, drive cross-functional prioritization, and help deeply technical teams, program stakeholders, and operators in the field understand each other.

Travel and Availability: Ability to travel up to 20% to support customer needs and operations, and to work non-standard hours when fielded operations require it.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Proven Technical Leadership: 8+ years of professional experience managing, mastering, and supporting complex technical systems (robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, or other electromechanical domains).

- Education: Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, OR equivalent hands-on technical experience (military, industrial, or field support).

- Organizational Leadership: Experience leading managers and multi-team organizations, with accountability for outcomes across more than one product line or program.

- Incident Workflow Ownership: Experience owning incident-driven workflows at a standard-setting level, including triage, diagnosis, severity assignment, escalation, and resolution across a fielded fleet.

- Technical Depth: Enough technical depth to follow the work of engineers and specialists supporting fielded robotic and electromechanical systems, including the ability to reason across hardware, software, and networking boundaries.

- Reliability Workflow Familiarity: Demonstrated familiarity with product improvement or reliability lifecycles and processes.

- Sustainment Approach: Experience defining a sustainment model for fielded hardware across its service life, spanning maintenance, spares, and the tooling or self-service investments that reduce support burden.

- Capacity and Cost Modeling: Experience building and defending quantitative models that size support demand, headcount, or cost, including owning annual planning for a function and stating the assumptions behind the model.

- Program Management: Project and program management ability applied outside a project management role: decomposing requirements into deliverables, synthesizing information from several sources into a clear recommendation, and driving that recommendation to a result across multiple functions.

- Executive Influence: Proven ability to align senior cross-functional leadership and influence outcomes without authority over the people who deliver them, including briefing executive stakeholders on operational performance.

- Communication: Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, and confidence navigating ambiguity and establishing new ways of working where none exist.

- Clearance: Active or eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security clearance. Holding clearances or background investigations in the past is a plus.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

We recognize that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. We do not expect you to meet every single one of these criteria:

- Experience establishing a product support or sustainment function from the ground up, including defining the operating model, growing the team, and running remote support operations for complex robotics systems.

- Defense, law enforcement, or other government agency experience leading air defense, intelligence, and/or force protection teams.

- Consulting or process maturation project experience, and formal training or certification in a continuous improvement or project management disciplines (such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Agile, or PMP).

- Fluency with structured root cause methods such as fault tree analysis, fishbone, or 8D problem solving.

- Working knowledge of reliability engineering fundamentals, including failure distributions, mean time between failure and maintenance, and reliability growth.

- Hands-on exposure to the failure behavior of fielded robotic and sensor systems, including actuation, power systems, sensing, embedded compute, radar, RF detection, and electro-optical and infrared sensing, and the ability to diagnose connectivity and networking faults across distributed field systems.

- Comfort reading logs, telemetry, and test data, including hands-on use of Linux command-line interfaces and tooling such as Grafana, Datadog, Jira, Git, SQL, and Palantir Foundry.

- Experience translating support scope into contract or pricing structures for operations and sustainment, and familiarity with proposal efforts.

- Fluency with the data layer of sustainment, including incident management systems, asset and configuration data, service bill of materials, and cost association.

- Experience in on-call support operations and limited risk tolerance environments.

- An active U.S. Secret clearance or higher, prior military service, or a defense and STEM background.

US Salary Range
$147,000 — $196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-
No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Meta is seeking a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to drive data collection programs, AI-powered automation, and model and data evaluation at our capture facility. Reality Labs builds the next generation of computing across Meta’s Hardware Products mixed reality, virtual reality, and wearables, and capabilities like hand tracking, eye tracking, body tracking, and holograms dependent on machine learning models trained on high-quality human data.
Our scope spans the full lifecycle of the data: running the onsite collections that produce it, deploying AI and automation to scale how it is processed and checked, and building the evaluation practices that measure model performance against it. A session in one of our facilities can become part of what teaches a device to recognize a gesture, follow a gaze, or anchor a hologram.
If you are energized by hands-on operational work, prototype hardware, and AI-driven workflows, this role is for you. You will be responsible for translating engineering and research requirements into repeatable collection protocols, deploying the automation and AI tooling that scales them, and owning and collaborating with the hardware, tooling, and quality teams that make each collection reproducible.

raw.description:
Overview
We are advancing technological innovation through quantum computing, which has the potential to reshape how complex problems are addressed in science, medicine, materials research, and industry. At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower scientists to solve some of the world's biggest problems by developing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology.
The Microsoft Quantum team is dedicated to developing the first scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computer. Our work spans quantum hardware, error correction, and integration with Azure. Our accomplished, diverse international team is focused on building a scalable quantum computing system. Our full-stack strategy encompasses breakthroughs in quantum device physics, scalable readout, and control infrastructure powered by cryoelectronics. As quantum computing enters a pivotal phase of accelerated growth, this position offers an opportunity to contribute to a transformative technology.
Microsoft is seeking a Quantum Technical Program Manager (TPM), at the Senior to Principal level , to lead the end-to-end delivery of next-generation quantum hardware systems. You will drive cross-functional execution across research, engineering, and external partners to develop scalable, production-ready quantum solutions. Working closely with subsystem research and development leaders in areas such as control, packaging, and test and measurement, you will align roadmaps, manage risks, and deliver critical milestones. This high-impact leadership role calls for deep technical expertise, strong program management skills, and a customer-focused mindset.
You will collaborate with physicists, quantum theorists, experimentalists, research and systems engineers, technical program managers, supply chain experts, cloud architects, and external partners to accelerate the scale-up of topological qubits and quantum systems. If you thrive on complex program challenges, can navigate ambiguity, and are passionate about foundational technologies, we invite you to help shape the future of quantum computing.
At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities
- Drive program execution: Lead program management for pivotal quantum hardware initiatives, from concept development and engineering design through prototyping, validation, operational scaling, and ongoing delivery. Collaborate with system architects, research scientists, and hardware engineers to achieve program goals.
- Strategic planning and roadmapping: Work with program management leadership, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders to develop and maintain a roadmap for hardware platform advancement. Align technical milestones, resources, schedules, and risk responses with Microsoft Quantum's long-term goals.
- Cross-disciplinary coordination: Align teams working in quantum device physics, cryoelectronics, materials science, hardware control, manufacturing, supply chain, integration, and cloud hardware operations to deliver reliable, scalable hardware solutions.
- Supplier and partner engagement: Manage relationships with external foundries, research laboratories, equipment vendors, and strategic partners. Establish clear requirements and support compliance with Microsoft's standards for quality, safety, and data security.
- Risk management: Identify, monitor, and mitigate technical, schedule, and operational risks. Apply lessons learned and adapt plans as technologies and program needs evolve.
- Agile delivery: Oversee Agile program processes and ceremonies, provide regular reviews and updates, and remove obstacles to the timely delivery of critical milestones.
- Customer focus: Incorporate feedback from internal and pilot customers, including researchers, manufacturing partners, and Azure Quantum platform teams, to improve hardware and processes.
- Executive communication: Develop concise, data-driven updates on program status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and impact for executive and other stakeholders.
- Culture and values: Promote respect, collaboration, integrity, and inclusivity. Mentor team members and foster a learning-oriented environment within the quantum TPM organization.
- Other: Embody Microsoft's Culture and Values .

Qualifications
Required qualifications
- Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience in engineering, product or technical program management, data analysis, or product development, or equivalent experience.
- 2+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
Other requirements
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screenings:
- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position requires passing the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.
- Citizenship and citizenship verification: This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.
Preferred qualifications
- An advanced degree (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) in a relevant field, such as quantum information, physics, materials science, electrical engineering, or hardware systems; or equivalent applied experience in quantum or cryogenic hardware programs.
- 10+ years of experience managing multi-year, highly complex hardware product portfolios involving deep technology or first-of-a-kind technology, such as board or SoC bring-up, BIOS and driver development, quantum systems, ASICs, FPGAs, advanced chip packaging, cryoelectronics, or high-reliability hardware.
- Direct experience with quantum device development, quantum error correction, or quantum measurement and control hardware.
- Hands-on development or testing experience with quantum hardware systems, including cryogenic systems.
- Experience with semiconductor, electronics, or advanced materials supply chains, contract manufacturers, or research and development foundries.
- Demonstrated success leading external research, university, government, or consortium partnerships in advanced hardware or scientific domains.
- Experience transferring technology from research and development to scaled engineering and manufacturing, including developing and auditing hardware quality systems and test protocols.
- Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced product development environment within a matrixed organization.
- Ability to use AI tools to improve innovation and efficiency, such as performance modeling and analysis, research gathering, and day-to-day task automation.
- Experience applying AI to engineering and lab workflows, including designing and building agents or copilots that assist with experiment setup, log triage, measurement reports, protocol templates, and knowledge retrieval.
- Experience evaluating agentic solutions using measurable metrics and human-in-the-loop safeguards in accordance with Microsoft Responsible AI requirements for generative AI.

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. raw.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.




ABOUT THIS ROLE:

Crusoe is a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company with a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. Our competitive advantage—“Speed is the only moat”—is directly tied to our ability to rapidly design, deploy, and optimize our modular power and compute infrastructure.

We are seeking a Senior Staff Data Center Systems Engineer, R&D to join our R&D team as the senior technical authority responsible for defining the future of Crusoe’s data center architecture. You will evaluate next-generation technologies—working with emerging startups, established industry providers, and research institutions—and lead the development of system-level integration concepts that advance Crusoe’s infrastructure from pilot-scale validation through hyperscale deployment.

This is a rare role in the industry. At most companies, power engineers never talk to compute architects, and facility designers work in isolation from software teams. As part of Crusoe’s R&D organization, you will work at the seams between these disciplines—scanning the industry for emerging technologies, building relationships with the companies and researchers developing them, defining reference architectures for future platforms, and partnering with engineering teams across the company to take R&D concepts from bench-scale evaluation to production deployment. If you want to shape the next generation of AI data center technologies, this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON:

 - Future Architecture Definition: Lead the development of next-generation data center reference architectures that integrate across electrical, mechanical, thermal, and compute domains. Evaluate how emerging technologies reshape design assumptions and define the architectural path from pilot-scale validation through hyperscale deployment.

 - Technology Evaluation & Industry Scanning: Continuously scan the industry for emerging technologies, new vendor capabilities, and evolving standards that could impact data center architecture. Lead structured evaluations of candidate technologies through a full-system lens—assessing not just point performance, but how each technology integrates within the broader infrastructure and scales from prototype to production.

 - Systems Integration: Define and maintain the systems-level architecture that governs how Crusoe’s infrastructure layers interface and co-optimize. Ensure coherence across engineering disciplines and prevent design decisions in one domain from creating constraints elsewhere.

 - Pilot-to-Hyperscale Progression: Guide emerging technologies through the full lifecycle—from initial evaluation and bench-scale testing through pilot deployment, production validation, and hyperscale rollout. Define the technical criteria and milestones that determine readiness at each stage.

 - R&D Technical Leadership: Serve as the principal technical voice within the R&D organization on infrastructure architecture. Drive feasibility assessments, lead design reviews for pilot programs, and provide senior technical input on go/no-go decisions for emerging technologies.

 - Specifications & Standards: Author high-level system specifications, interface control documents, and design standards that inform future platform development. Translate R&D findings into actionable engineering guidance for production teams.

 - Engineering Team Partnership: Partner with engineering teams across the company as R&D’s primary technical interface—sharing insights from technology evaluations, translating domain-specific decisions into system-wide implications, and ensuring R&D outputs are aligned with the needs of the teams building and deploying infrastructure.

 - External Partnerships: Build and maintain technical relationships with industry providers, emerging startups, OEMs, academic research groups, and national laboratories. Evaluate vendor and partner roadmaps, test claims, and identify opportunities for early access to next-generation technologies and collaborative development.

 - Strategic Advisory: Partner with R&D and company leadership on technology choices that support Crusoe’s long-term growth strategy. Help shape the company’s perspective on where the industry is headed and how Crusoe should position itself.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM:

 - Experience: 15+ years of progressive engineering experience in data center design, large-scale infrastructure, hyperscale computing environments, or industrial power systems. A career trajectory that demonstrates increasing scope across multiple engineering disciplines.

 - Systems Thinking: Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize across multiple engineering domains simultaneously—electrical power systems, mechanical/thermal systems, compute infrastructure, and facility design. Comfortable operating at the interfaces between disciplines rather than deep within a single domain.

 - Technical Breadth: Working knowledge spanning power generation and distribution, cooling technologies (including direct liquid cooling), data center facility design, and compute/networking infrastructure.

 - R&D Orientation: A natural inclination toward evaluating what’s next, not just optimizing what exists. Experience leading technology evaluations, feasibility studies, or architectural explorations that informed future product or infrastructure direction. Comfortable engaging with startups, research institutions, and emerging technology providers.

 - Architecture & Documentation: Experience authoring system-level architecture documents, interface specifications, and integration standards for complex multi-disciplinary programs.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence and align engineering teams across organizational boundaries without direct authority. Track record of driving technical consensus across disciplines with competing priorities.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred but not required.

 - Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering peers and executive leadership.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Direct experience at a hyperscale in a systems architecture or principal engineering role.

 - Experience with modular or containerized data center design and deployment.

 - Familiarity with DC power distribution architectures.

 - Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) and GPU-accelerated AI infrastructure at scale.

 - Background in mission-critical facility design with understanding of redundancy, reliability, and availability engineering.

The next breakthrough in artificial intelligence (AI) needs more than powerful accelerators: it needs a network that makes them work as a supercomputer. On Azure Networking’s infrastructure team, you build networking for Microsoft-developed AI accelerators and GPUs from NVIDIA, AMD and other suppliers. As a Senior Technical Program Manager in Azure Networking, you will own the introduction of the next-generation Ethernet platform for regional networking at Microsoft scale, from requirements and regional network design through interoperability validation, workload testing, operational readiness and staged production deployments. This opportunity will allow you to expand your influence on regional network architecture at Microsoft scale; deepen your expertise in workload-driven platform decisions; and extend your technical leadership across engineering, operations and industry partners.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

raw.title: Global Supply Manager, Capital Equipment & Construction (Starship)
raw.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, CAPITAL EQUIPMENT & CONSTRUCTION (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is on a fast track to become the market leader in various product categories like internet services through the Starlink constellation, US based human spaceflight, rapid vehicle reusability, and others exciting projects. The SpaceX Supply Chain Department is a critical player in our operations.  The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics and inventory. SpaceX Supply Chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute in making us a multi-planetary species. This individual will support construction projects and capital purchases for the construction and facilities organizations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work directly with key internal stakeholders to develop and implement a comprehensive contract management process that ensures a successful project execution cycle

- Create sourcing strategies for assigned categories to reduce risk and meet targets for the purchasing department including, but not limited to, payment terms, cash targets, and cost savings

- Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships to create strategic sourcing models that optimize the value of products and services that support business unit requirements to maintain continuous cost reduction programs for controllable expenditures

- Identify and execute cost reduction projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and project updates

- Perform advanced quantitative and business process analyses to identify financial impacts of decisions, cost improvement, and performance for assigned categories

- Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers and measure the appropriate criteria such as delivery of business results, cost reduction, quality, and timeliness of delivery

- Conduct research, perform benchmarking, and gather market analysis for assigned categories

- Create contract documents in collaboration with the legal department

- Manage contracts to ensure the supplier's performance meets contract obligations

- Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creative solutions

- Maximize value and cost savings benefits while lowering risk through strategic negotiations

- Identify and drive year over year cost optimization through reducing usage and eliminating waste within our operations

- Establish preferred suppliers for assigned categories

- Create and implement management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage the performance of, and monitor KPIs of the supply base

- Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories

- Develop and lead efforts to reduce number of transactions and for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; OR 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:

- Engineering

- Purchasing

- Contract negotiation

- Material or production planning

- Operations or supply chain management

- Master production scheduling

- Construction, facilities, or industrial plant management

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Strong technical background to speak the language of engineers and strong business background to deal with contracts and negotiations

- Construction project management experience and/or construction cost estimate experience

- Familiarity or experience in purchasing or similar procurement related experience

- Experience in industrial engineering, construction management, and/or facilities management

- Strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills

- Extensive project management and organizational skills

- Experience managing large scale industrial and commercial construction projects

- Strong contract negotiation and document management skills

- Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed

- Quick learner and ability to prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs

- Excellent customer service skills

- Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

- Exceptional analytical and organizational skills

- Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, SQL, PowerBI, etc.)

- Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to work extended hours and some nights and weekends when needed

- Ability to travel and communicate outside of work hours - up to 30% travel may be required, including international travel

- Valid driver’s license

- This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Senior Technical Program Manager

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

HPE is seeking a Sr. level Technical Program Manager to work in our San Jose, California.  The Program Manager will provide support and lead teams through the Engineering development process and implementation of company’s products.

These projects are typically shorter-term, less complex and more contained with a defined time frame. While programs are typically longer-term, multi-functional, multi-project with complex requirements and effort. Manage activities, resource capability, schedules, budgets, and ensure cross company communications to facilitate product completion on schedule within budget.

The Program Manager will also work with engineering management to identify and improve process and program efficiencies. Work can involve external parties such as standards bodies, partners, etc.

The Program Manager will contribute to the impact of technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable.    Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

Location:      San Jose, California on a hybrid schedule.

Responsibilities:
- Manages and leads a program involving multiple functions and project teams to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a product or service offering.
- Develops and directs development of schedules, critical deliverables, budget, resource allocation plan, and other support requirements for assigned program.
- Manages activities of supporting project teams and internal development partners; ensures progress against established plan and makes determinations based on analysis of business information to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
- Communicates program progress, escalations, and issue analysis to product stakeholders; collaborates with management and internal manufacturing and development partners to recommend and implement changes to product, processes, or business practices to resolve escalated issues, produce solutions, and ensure adherence to budgets and established product roadmaps and schedules
- Drives innovation and integration of new technologies and quality initiatives into projects and activities in the manufacturing and/or engineering organization.
- Leads and provides guidance and mentoring to less-experienced staff members.

Education and Experience Required:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or equivalent.
- PMP/PMI certification preferred.
- 6+ years of program manager experience.

Knowledge and Skills:
- Hands on experience in development of Hardware & Software products for the Networking industry or related IT fields.
- Experience in managing and/or development of SW solutions deployed on public cloud. Knowledge of DevOps development models using agile concepts
- Experience using AI related tools to manage Program management tasks and deliverables.
- Extensive experience with using project and program planning tools and software packages to create, manage, and track project results.
- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
- Demonstrated business acumen and successful experience managing all aspects of programs, including communicating with stakeholders and directing matrixed teams and resources.

raw.title: Manufacturing Operations Manager, AD&S
raw.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE SITE

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1, its first hyper-scale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed at which autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America's defense industrial base, strengthening America's warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) is the team at Anduril responsible for producing the family of autonomous air vehicles and precision effects that define the modern fight, including Fury, Barracuda, and RoadRunner, as well as a wide array of emerging capabilities. New adversaries and the new economics of warfare demand mass, and our products are rapidly scaling in production to deliver the volumes our customers need. You will own one of these products in production and drive its production ramp, from rapidly maturing prototypes through full-rate production at scale. Your work will help change the balance of defense capabilities on a global scale. This team will have the opportunity to train under our world-class manufacturing team at Anduril HQ in Costa Mesa, CA for three months before bringing that standard of excellence back to Ohio.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Manufacturing Operations Manager to join our growing team supporting Arsenal-1. Here you will work on cutting-edge technology aimed at advancing the state of the possible. The Manufacturing Operations Manager will manage a team of highly talented technicians producing multiple platforms of hardware for strategic military customers, reporting to the Director of Manufacturing Operations for AD&S. This is a highly dynamic role that requires both frontline technical and people-management skills. This role is at the forefront of delivering exceptional customer outcomes, fostering team development, and overseeing day-to-day production and delivery operations. Success in this role demands consistent achievement across hardware production, team management, manufacturing operations, and financial goals.

The ideal candidate has experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) and the technical acumen to communicate effectively across the floor and with engineering. We are looking for a highly organized, self-motivated individual who is energetic, deeply committed to scaling innovative products, and passionate about driving transformative change. While we value strong individual contributions, teamwork is crucial to success here, and to maintaining our Anduril culture above all.

This role will be based at Arsenal-01 in Columbus, OH, and may require candidates to relocate to Costa Mesa, CA for a three-month training program. Housing, transportation, and related costs will be provided during your stay.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage technician staff in the production and delivery of AD&S hardware through factory acceptance. You will have the critical task of managing the priorities, equipment, and people associated with the production line.

- Set priorities and direct daily operations, including the timely issuing and completion of work orders to the production floor.

- Ensure all operators follow safety procedures and that their teams' safety training is current, document EHS incidents, proactively correct workplace hazards, and empower others to continuously improve operations.

- Manage, coach, mentor, and support production technicians.

- Prioritize work activities for operators to achieve target on-time delivery goals.

- Ensure quality standards are met throughout the entire production process, and support no defects leaving a station or team area.

- Own the culture on your line: be a stakeholder in the programs and policies that affect life on the floor, and maintain a high bar for excellence while building a strong team.

- Provide clear, high-quality reports out to Production Managers, the Director of Manufacturing Operations, and the Head of Manufacturing as needed.

- Be an active participant in 5S and continuous improvement activities.

- Complete transactions in production systems (NetSuite, JIRA Anduril MES) on a daily basis.

- Work cross-functionally with Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering, Planning, Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure inventory levels are maintained and accurate in each work area.

- Provide a weekly report-out of production progress, blockers, risks, and needs, and generate daily pass-downs and weekly production reports for the engineering and operations teams.

- Lead daily communication with cross-functional teams, including engineering, technicians, supply chain, logistics, and quality, as necessary.

- Build a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes product knowledge, skills development, and cross-training.

- Show up every day with a high level of urgency, ownership, and enthusiasm to get the job done.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of experience in production-oriented or electro-mechanical technician fields, with at least 3+ years in a supervisor or production operations lead/manager role in a high-volume production environment.

- Experience working with ERP and MES systems.

- A full understanding of the product life cycle (NPI to scaled production), LEAN manufacturing principles, and change management (ECOs).

- Ability to interpret technical documentation (mechanical drawings, work instructions, building plans, equipment specifications, electrical schematics, and similar).

- Experience working directly and communicating with designers and engineers.

- Extremely reliable, organized, and detail-oriented, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- A passion for employee development, and enjoyment of the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran production staff.

- Proven skills in both process and equipment troubleshooting, allowing you to adapt easily to constantly changing production environments.

- Experience supporting process development.

- Knowledge of 5S, lean manufacturing, or 6-Sigma principles.

- Proficiency with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project).

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- New Product Introduction (NPI) experience.

- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field (engineering, business, or applied science).

- Lean Six Sigma green belt certification.

- Working knowledge of AS9100 standards and OSHA laws.

US Salary Range
$111,000 — $147,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. -

-
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

raw.title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer (Data Center MEP Systems)
raw.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. MECHANICAL ENGINEER (DATA CENTER MEP SYSTEMS)

SpaceX is looking for an MEP Engineer with deep mechanical and plumbing expertise to design, specify, and commission the cooling and fluid systems that keep our data center infrastructure running. This role sits at the intersection of critical facilities engineering and the physical plant — you’ll be equally comfortable in a design review and walking a mechanical room during startup.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design and specify mechanical cooling systems for data center facilities: chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC units, air handling units, and cooling towers

- Own plumbing system design: domestic water, sanitary, storm drainage, makeup water, and process piping for cooling systems

- Evaluate and specify facility liquid cooling infrastructure (direct-to-chip, rear-door heat exchangers, immersion cooling)

- Perform heat load calculations, airflow modeling, and capacity planning to ensure design requirements are met

- Develop piping design, pump sizing, and hydraulic calculations for chilled water and condenser water loops

- Review and coordinate mechanical/plumbing drawings with architectural, electrical, structural, and fire protection disciplines

- Support commissioning of mechanical systems: functional performance testing, integrated systems testing (IST), and level 5 commissioning for critical cooling infrastructure

- Work directly with equipment vendors (chillers, CRAH units, pumps, cooling towers) on technical specifications and factory witness testing

- Troubleshoot operational issues in existing facilities — water treatment, pump cavitation, control valve failures, capacity shortfalls

- Support due diligence and technical evaluation for new site selection, including utility water availability and existing mechanical infrastructure condition

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline

- 10+ years of experience in mechanical/plumbing design for mission-critical facilities, data centers, or comparable industrial environments

raw.title: Staff T&E Technical Program Manager, Strategic Defense
raw.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Defense protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale.

ABOUT THE JOB

Our team is actively seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Staff Test & Evaluation (T&E) Technical Program Manager (TPM) to quickly integrate into the team. In this role, you will support the Anduril Strategic Defense business line with your technical expertise and foster strategic collaboration across various teams. This includes working closely with program leadership, supporting companies, and government partners. As a valued member of our team, you will play an integral role in testing innovative solutions designed to address real-world challenges. A significant part of your role will involve serving as the government point of contact, coordinating with other capability stakeholders on test objectives, and shaping test scenario requirements to drive Anduril's engineering priorities. This position underscores the importance of an iterative approach to our operations - design, test, field, and refine - thereby driving continuous improvement of our systems and services. As part of a growing T&E team, this role may be asked to support both ground and flight test activities until the full team is in place.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- As a T&E TPM, under minimal supervision, you will determine and develop various approaches to achieve T&E goals and help guide and perform the completion of test
activities, with a particular emphasis on hardware-in-the-loop lab-based ground tests.

- Coordinate and support execution of testing at private and government owned test ranges to test and evaluate hardware and software systems.

- Deconflict test events internally across Anduril programs and efforts.

- Be responsible for safe operation of all testing efforts, working in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

- Work closely with Engineering to discuss test results, to include collected data and observations.

- Collect and perform initial test data analysis for the system under test.

- Support the design and implementation of live-virtual-constructive (LVC) test scenarios to stress the system under test without requiring live assets.

- Document test procedures and results, providing detailed reports for engineering teams and stakeholders.

- Conduct testing of classified capabilities in an unclassified setting, working with customer and Anduril security teams to ensure all protocols and security measures are adhered to.

- Integrate T&E processes into the program, ensure adherence throughout the life of the program.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related technical field from an accredited institution.

- Current Top Secret Security Clearance.

- 10+ years of experience in technical program or project management, engineering management, engineering, or comparable skill, preferably supporting testing teams.

- Strong technical background with familiarity in systems engineering and/or software development.

- Must be able to execute the full test engineering process for a System-of-Systems (requirements, test planning, readiness reviews, safety reviews, test execution, test reporting, etc.) with little to no oversight utilizing company test and evaluation policy.

- Experience producing customer facing test deliverables (test plans, test reports, data analysis, etc.) and demonstrated maturity to articulate deliverable to a variety of stakeholders.

- Experience as a test conductor, test director, or similar role while executing testing.

- Experience executing ground test campaigns in hardware and/or software integration lab environments, including stimulus generation and truth system integration.

- Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and solve problems across a variety of engineering areas.

- Must be able to work independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team to deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced environment with little to no oversight.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with the Department of Defense and/or Intelligence Community, particularly with the Missile Defense Agency.

- Experience in C++, Python, or other programming languages for data analysis.

- Familiarity with live-virtual-constructive (LVC) frameworks and simulation environments.

- Experience designing or operating hardware integration lab test benches, including bench fidelity assessment.

- Ability and willingness to travel to test sites for extended periods to serve as on-site test execution lead, approximately twice per year.

US Salary Range
$165,000 — $219,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-
No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process.
